text: Skip to main content About Form 706-NA, United States Estate (and Generation-Skipping Transfer) Tax Return More In Forms and Instructions Current year Prior year Accessible eBooks Browser-friendly forms and publications Mobile-friendly forms Post release changes to forms Order forms and publications Help with forms and instructions Comment on tax forms and publications Use this form to compute estate and generation-skipping transfer (GST) tax liability for nonresident alien decedents. The estate tax is imposed on the transfer of the decedent's taxable estate rather than on the receipt of any part of it.
